rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow—vacatur and remand for inadequate explanation/unfair surprise under Fox/Encino/Regents—while emphasizing deference to FDA’s scientific judgments and rejecting any notion that guidance creates a safe harbor. Separate writings are most likely from Alito (and possibly Barrett) to argue this was merely an application-specific sufficiency determination under State Farm, and from Gorsuch/Thomas to sharpen the “unfair surprise” and reliance-interest analysis.
